title: Package Name Check
description: Stops an npm or pip install pulling in a typosquat by reading the install command or requirements list package by package and catching lookalikes of popular packages (loadsh, crossenv, cross-env.js, jeIlyfish with a capital I, colourama), import names that aren't the package to install (sklearn, cv2, bs4, PIL), built-ins installed from the registry (fs, crypto, json), names npm or PyPI can't publish, and, through an optional registry lookup, names that don't exist yet (the AI-hallucination trap) or appeared days ago with almost no downloads, each with a one-tap switch to the real package.
